extDesc.message: Export WhatsApp chats as CSV or text — one file per chat, with date range filtering and Safe Mode.

safeModeDesc.message: Adds delays between chats to reduce ban risk. Recommended for 5+ chats.

statusLoaded.message: chats loaded. Select which to export.

statusLoadFailed.message: Failed to load chats. Make sure WhatsApp Web is logged in.

statusExportStarted.message: Export started. You can switch tabs — WhatsApp tab must stay open.

statusSafeModeStarted.message: Export started (Safe Mode). You can switch tabs — WhatsApp tab must stay open.

statusFailed.message: No messages found in the selected date range.

errorApiNotReady.message: WhatsApp Web has been updated — WA Group Exporter needs an update. Please check for a newer version.

errorWhatsAppNotOpen.message: Please open WhatsApp Web (web.whatsapp.com) and log in first.
